detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A potion mishap in Hello Kitty’s Cafe opens the door to the whimsical world of Wheatflour Wonderland and a brand new character: Cogimyun, the Wheatflour Fairy! Throughout your journey you’ll craft powerful wands, discover the secrets of beautiful gemstones, and transform into your most magical self.

  • Befriend Cogimyun for the first time ever, with 35 friendship levels to unlock

  • Craft magical wands that let you cast magic, transform into critters, or become items around the world!

  • Find hidden collectible Wheathearts in puzzles throughout our largest world since launch

  • Discover new cooking and crafting opportunities that let you customize outfits like never before

  • Grow the wondrous Wheatflower and discover the glitter effect, bringing a new sparkle to the game

  • Meet Cogimyun’s pet, Ebi Fry, and her adorable little brother, Cogimyon

  • Unlock new character furniture and whimsical cabins, and decorate to your heart’s content

  • Play 3 delightful new mini-games–one with friends!
